title: JSON schema for Blockstudio page collection manifests

collection.description: Collection slug. A collection with scope collection uses it as its URL base.

defaults.description: Default page properties applied to every page of the collection, including render. A default render applies to a page only when its entry exists in the page directory.

meta.description: Custom collection metadata. Unknown manifest keys are also stored here.

postType.description: Post type inherited by collection pages. If missing, pages sync as normal WordPress pages.

postTypeArgs.description: register_post_type() arguments used when the collection registers its own post type. show_in_rest defaults to true.

scope.description: collection namespaces page keys and paths under the collection and routes them under its URL base. site groups the standalone pages below the manifest: their keys, paths, WordPress page URLs and nearest layouts stay as they are without a manifest, and nested pages.json manifests keep their own collections.
